scripts.build:dev: node scripts/build_common.js --dev && node scripts/build_background.js --dev && node scripts/build_content_script.js --dev && node scripts/build_inject.js
scripts.build: npm run build:common && npm run build:background && npm run build:content && npm run build:inject && npm run package
scripts.test: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); const files = fs.readdirSync('tests').filter(f => f.startsWith('test_') && f.endsWith('.js')); let passed = 0, failed = 0; for (const f of files) { try { cp.execSync('node tests/' + f, { stdio: 'pipe' }); passed++; } catch (err) { console.error('FAIL: ' + f); failed++; } } console.log('\nFINAL TEST RESULTS: ' + passed + ' passed, ' + failed + ' failed.'); if (failed > 0) process.exit(1);"
